title: Complaint rejection exception
description: Complaint rejection with opportunity to be heard

content.general_rule: The District Commission may reject a complaint
content.exception: A complaint shall not be rejected unless an opportunity of being heard has been given to the complainant
conditions: an opportunity of being heard has been given to the complainant
